response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.observstation IN (SELECT DISTINCT observstation FROM telescopes WHERE equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND equipstatus != 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: The equipstatus criterion applies to filtering which individual telescopes are counted and included in bandwidth averaging, not just determining which stations to include. Only count and average metrics for telescopes where equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND equipstatus != 'Maintenance'.
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.observstation IN (SELECT DISTINCT observstation FROM telescopes WHERE equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND equipstatus != 'Maintenance') AND t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND t.equipstatus != 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
